_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change followup-public-progress (REQ-FPP-001, REQ-FPP-002, matrix row fol-06). A commitment carries dated progress entries the clerk adds from its page; the public ORI commitments resource serves them once the publication date has passed.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Dated progress entries, added by the chair or secretary of the meeting the commitment was made in. Public on the ORI commitments resource from the publication date on.
